comments.body: Bro this biryani was so flavourful🔥
The pizza crust was perfectly crispy!
Best butter chicken I've had in months.
These noodles were spicy but addictive 😭🔥
Paneer tikka was smoky and soft!
Juicy patties and perfect cheese melt.
That chocolate cake was heaven 😍
Loved the fresh veggies in the salad.
Thali quantity was too good for the price!
The samosas were perfectly fried.
Mango shake felt natural and thick!
Fries were hot and crisp till the last bite.
Chicken roll was huge and juicy.
Masala dosa was crispy and yum.
Fried rice had perfect wok flavour.
Mirchi bajji hit different on rainy days 😍
Freshly baked cookies were soft and warm.
Oreo shake was so thick and creamy!
Waffles were crunchy outside, soft inside.
Perfect buttery pav bhaji, elite taste.
